# Glossary

Plain-language definitions of the patterns and technologies that appear across this portfolio, each linked to the projects that use them.

Looking for a specific kind of experience? The same terms are grouped by job role:

- [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md): Self-hosted clusters, isolation boundaries, provisioning automation and the operational tooling that keeps them observable and recoverable.
- [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md): Concurrency control, event-driven pipelines, protocol work and data models that stay correct under load.
- [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md): Defence in depth by architecture: isolation, least privilege, secret brokerage, cryptographic proofs and audit trails.
- [Frontend & Product Engineering](docs/roles/frontend-product.md): Interactive, real-time and server-rendered interfaces, from browser DSP to GIS dashboards to multi-brand SSR.
- [Solutions Architecture & Technical Consulting](docs/roles/solutions-architecture.md): Turning multi-stakeholder problems into delivered systems: commercial models, public-sector and non-profit outcomes, and systems thinking.

**Jump to:** [A](#a) · [B](#b) · [C](#c) · [D](#d) · [E](#e) · [F](#f) · [G](#g) · [H](#h) · [I](#i) · [L](#l) · [M](#m) · [N](#n) · [O](#o) · [P](#p) · [R](#r) · [S](#s) · [V](#v) · [W](#w) · [Z](#z)

### A

**Abstract Syntax Tree (AST)**  
A tree representation of an expression or program. Transforming the tree rather than the text keeps every change structurally valid.  
*Projects:* [16 Expression Complexity Engine](projects/16-algorithmic-expression-complexity-engine/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md), [Frontend & Product Engineering](docs/roles/frontend-product.md)

**Adaptive Bitrate Streaming (HLS)**  
Video split into short segments at several quality levels so each viewer's player can switch quality to match their connection.  
*Projects:* [13 Livestreaming Platform](projects/13-low-latency-event-broadcast-platform/profile.md), [09 Geospatial Stream Dashboard](projects/09-geospatial-live-stream-intelligence-dashboard/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md), [Frontend & Product Engineering](docs/roles/frontend-product.md)

**Append-Only Ledger**  
A store where records are only ever added, never edited or deleted, so history can be replayed and audited.  
*Projects:* [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md), [03 Competition & Prize Platform](projects/03-competition-prize-gaming-platform/profile.md), [16 Expression Complexity Engine](projects/16-algorithmic-expression-complexity-engine/profile.md), [18 Game Server RCON Orchestrator](projects/18-dedicated-game-server-rcon-orchestrator/profile.md), [21 Assisted Meal Delivery Platform](projects/21-nutritional-logistics-assisted-delivery-platform/profile.md), [22 Social Enterprise Portal](projects/22-non-profit-community-social-enterprise-portal/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md), [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md)

**Applied Systems Theory (Stocks & Flows)**  
Donella Meadows' method of modelling a system as stocks (things that accumulate), flows (rates that change them) and feedback loops. Every project profile includes one of these diagrams.  
*Projects:* [26 Portfolio Engine](projects/26-principal-systems-engineering-portfolio/profile.md), [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md), [04 Capacity Modeling Engine](projects/04-cognitive-capacity-modeling-engine/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Solutions Architecture & Technical Consulting](docs/roles/solutions-architecture.md)

**Audit Trail**  
A tamper-evident record of who did what and when, kept so decisions can be reviewed by regulators, funders or operators.  
*Projects:* [03 Competition & Prize Platform](projects/03-competition-prize-gaming-platform/profile.md), [08 Workforce Scheduling Engine](projects/08-enterprise-workforce-scheduling-engine/profile.md), [18 Game Server RCON Orchestrator](projects/18-dedicated-game-server-rcon-orchestrator/profile.md), [21 Assisted Meal Delivery Platform](projects/21-nutritional-logistics-assisted-delivery-platform/profile.md), [22 Social Enterprise Portal](projects/22-non-profit-community-social-enterprise-portal/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md), [Solutions Architecture & Technical Consulting](docs/roles/solutions-architecture.md)

### B

**Backpressure**  
Slowing or shedding incoming work when a downstream stage is full, instead of letting queues grow until something breaks.  
*Projects:* [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md), [02 EPOS TCP Proxy Middleware](projects/02-epos-tcp-proxy-middleware/profile.md), [24 ChatOps Telemetry Microservice](projects/24-automated-chatops-telemetry-microservice/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md), [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

### C

**ChatOps**  
Running operational alerts and actions through team chat so the whole team sees system state where they already work.  
*Projects:* [24 ChatOps Telemetry Microservice](projects/24-automated-chatops-telemetry-microservice/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

**Community Interest Company (CIC)**  
A UK social-enterprise company type that must show its activity benefits the community, which drives statutory outcome reporting.  
*Projects:* [22 Social Enterprise Portal](projects/22-non-profit-community-social-enterprise-portal/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Solutions Architecture & Technical Consulting](docs/roles/solutions-architecture.md)

**Connection Pooling**  
Reusing a fixed set of open database connections instead of opening one per request, which caps load and cuts latency.  
*Projects:* [25 MEEN Full-Stack Scaffold](projects/25-monolithic-relational-fullstack-scaffold/profile.md), [17 DB Introspection Console](projects/17-dynamic-relational-db-introspection-console/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md)

**Copy-on-Write (CoW) Snapshots**  
Filesystem snapshots (here ZFS) that share unchanged blocks, so a fresh sandbox can be cloned in seconds and thrown away cleanly.  
*Projects:* [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md), [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md)

### D

**Data Sovereignty**  
Keeping control of where data and code live and who can reach them, enforced by architecture (self-hosting, isolation, mirrors) rather than by vendor policy.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [19 Git Mirror Automation](projects/19-sovereign-git-continuous-mirror-automation/profile.md), [22 Social Enterprise Portal](projects/22-non-profit-community-social-enterprise-portal/profile.md), [26 Portfolio Engine](projects/26-principal-systems-engineering-portfolio/profile.md), [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Solutions Architecture & Technical Consulting](docs/roles/solutions-architecture.md), [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md), [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

**DEFCON 0 (Zero-Egress Containment)**  
This portfolio's name for a sandbox whose outbound internet access is dropped at the host firewall by default and only allowed through named, isolated tunnels.  
*Projects:* [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md), [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md), [26 Portfolio Engine](projects/26-principal-systems-engineering-portfolio/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md), [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

**Defence in Depth**  
Layering independent controls (network, kernel, identity, application, audit) so one failure does not expose the whole system.  
*Projects:* [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md), [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md), [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [18 Game Server RCON Orchestrator](projects/18-dedicated-game-server-rcon-orchestrator/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md)

**Distributed Key Generation (DKG)**  
Creating a cryptographic key in pieces across parties so no single party ever holds the whole private key.  
*Projects:* [14 Web3 Notary Gateway](projects/14-decentralized-notary-web3-auth-gateway/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md)

**Dual-Database Isolation**  
Keeping credentials and audit data in a separate database from day-to-day business data, so routine backups and access never touch secrets.  
*Projects:* [08 Workforce Scheduling Engine](projects/08-enterprise-workforce-scheduling-engine/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md), [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md)

**Dynamic Schema Reflection**  
Reading a database's own metadata at runtime to build views and forms, without generated models or ORM mappings.  
*Projects:* [17 DB Introspection Console](projects/17-dynamic-relational-db-introspection-console/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md)

### E

**Edge Ingress (Reverse Proxy)**  
The front door (Caddy, Nginx) that terminates TLS, applies limits and routes traffic before it reaches application services.  
*Projects:* [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md), [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [12 Consultancy Routing Portal](projects/12-unified-multi-tenant-consultancy-routing-portal/profile.md), [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

**Engine + Paint Delivery**  
This portfolio's commercial model: a reusable, owned backend engine wrapped in a client-specific interface, so delivery is fast and core IP is retained.  
*Projects:* [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md), [12 Consultancy Routing Portal](projects/12-unified-multi-tenant-consultancy-routing-portal/profile.md), [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Solutions Architecture & Technical Consulting](docs/roles/solutions-architecture.md)

**Ephemeral Toolchain**  
Running build tools inside throwaway containers so nothing is installed on the host and every run starts from the same state.  
*Projects:* [23 Shopify Storefront Engine](projects/23-containerized-ecommerce-design-system/profile.md), [26 Portfolio Engine](projects/26-principal-systems-engineering-portfolio/profile.md), [09 Geospatial Stream Dashboard](projects/09-geospatial-live-stream-intelligence-dashboard/profile.md), [24 ChatOps Telemetry Microservice](projects/24-automated-chatops-telemetry-microservice/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md), [Frontend & Product Engineering](docs/roles/frontend-product.md)

**ESC/POS**  
The command language receipt and kitchen printers speak, including raster image modes.  
*Projects:* [02 EPOS TCP Proxy Middleware](projects/02-epos-tcp-proxy-middleware/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md)

**Exponential Backoff**  
Waiting progressively longer between retries after a rate-limit or failure response, so clients recover without hammering the service.  
*Projects:* [24 ChatOps Telemetry Microservice](projects/24-automated-chatops-telemetry-microservice/profile.md), [19 Git Mirror Automation](projects/19-sovereign-git-continuous-mirror-automation/profile.md), [11 Headless Scraping Cluster](projects/11-distributed-headless-scraping-cluster/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md), [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

### F

**Fail-Open**  
Choosing to pass traffic through unchanged when an optional processing step fails, because stopping service costs more than skipping the step.  
*Projects:* [02 EPOS TCP Proxy Middleware](projects/02-epos-tcp-proxy-middleware/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md), [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

**Feedback Loop (Balancing / Reinforcing)**  
A balancing loop pushes a system back toward a target (e.g. throttling); a reinforcing loop amplifies change (e.g. automation freeing time for more automation).  
*Projects:* [26 Portfolio Engine](projects/26-principal-systems-engineering-portfolio/profile.md), [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md), [04 Capacity Modeling Engine](projects/04-cognitive-capacity-modeling-engine/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Solutions Architecture & Technical Consulting](docs/roles/solutions-architecture.md)

### G

**GPU Passthrough**  
Giving a container or VM direct, fenced access to a physical GPU (or a slice of one) for local model inference.  
*Projects:* [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

### H

**Hazard Filtering**  
The redaction process used to build this portfolio: extracting the architecture of private work while stripping client identifiers and proprietary detail.  
*Projects:* [26 Portfolio Engine](projects/26-principal-systems-engineering-portfolio/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md), [Solutions Architecture & Technical Consulting](docs/roles/solutions-architecture.md)

**Headless Browser Automation**  
Driving a real browser engine without a screen (chromedp, Playwright) to render pages, extract data or print PDFs.  
*Projects:* [11 Headless Scraping Cluster](projects/11-distributed-headless-scraping-cluster/profile.md), [08 Workforce Scheduling Engine](projects/08-enterprise-workforce-scheduling-engine/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md)

**Host-Based Routing**  
Serving different sites or tenants from one deployment by reading the requested hostname.  
*Projects:* [12 Consultancy Routing Portal](projects/12-unified-multi-tenant-consultancy-routing-portal/profile.md), [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Frontend & Product Engineering](docs/roles/frontend-product.md), [Solutions Architecture & Technical Consulting](docs/roles/solutions-architecture.md)

**Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)**  
Automation that proposes actions but waits for an explicit human approval before high-impact changes are made.  
*Projects:* [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Solutions Architecture & Technical Consulting](docs/roles/solutions-architecture.md), [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md)

### I

**Idempotent Provisioning**  
Setup scripts that can be re-run safely and converge on the same result, usually guarded by pre-flight checks.  
*Projects:* [20 LXD Clustering Toolkit](projects/20-automated-lxd-clustering-provisioning-toolkit/profile.md), [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

**Infrastructure as Code (OpenTofu, Ansible)**  
Declaring infrastructure in versioned files so environments are reproducible, reviewable and checked for drift.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md), [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

### L

**LXD System Containers**  
Containers that run a full Linux userland like a lightweight VM. Run unprivileged, they are the main isolation unit across these projects.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md), [20 LXD Clustering Toolkit](projects/20-automated-lxd-clustering-provisioning-toolkit/profile.md), [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md), [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md)

### M

**Merkle Tree**  
A tree of hashes that lets many documents be proven with one root hash, so batches can be anchored on-chain cheaply.  
*Projects:* [14 Web3 Notary Gateway](projects/14-decentralized-notary-web3-auth-gateway/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md), [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md)

**Message Queue (BullMQ / Redis)**  
Handing slow work to background workers through a queue so the user-facing request returns quickly.  
*Projects:* [03 Competition & Prize Platform](projects/03-competition-prize-gaming-platform/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md)

**Modular Monolith**  
One deployable application with clear internal modules. Simpler and faster to run than microservices when the team and load allow.  
*Projects:* [25 MEEN Full-Stack Scaffold](projects/25-monolithic-relational-fullstack-scaffold/profile.md), [12 Consultancy Routing Portal](projects/12-unified-multi-tenant-consultancy-routing-portal/profile.md), [22 Social Enterprise Portal](projects/22-non-profit-community-social-enterprise-portal/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md), [Solutions Architecture & Technical Consulting](docs/roles/solutions-architecture.md)

**Multi-Tenancy**  
Serving many customers from one platform while keeping their data separate, here by schema, host or organisational scope.  
*Projects:* [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md), [04 Capacity Modeling Engine](projects/04-cognitive-capacity-modeling-engine/profile.md), [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md), [12 Consultancy Routing Portal](projects/12-unified-multi-tenant-consultancy-routing-portal/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md), [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md), [Solutions Architecture & Technical Consulting](docs/roles/solutions-architecture.md)

### N

**Network Namespace Egress**  
Forcing a workload's outbound traffic through a dedicated network namespace and tunnel (WireGuard, Tailscale) so it never touches the host's WAN address.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md), [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md)

### O

**Observability**  
Metrics, probes and dashboards (Prometheus, Grafana, Gatus) that show whether a system is healthy without logging into it.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [24 ChatOps Telemetry Microservice](projects/24-automated-chatops-telemetry-microservice/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

**OIDC Single Sign-On**  
Central identity (here Authentik) that every internal service trusts, instead of each keeping its own passwords.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md), [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

**Optical Character Recognition (OCR)**  
Turning images of text into machine-readable text, here run in memory on decoded printer images.  
*Projects:* [02 EPOS TCP Proxy Middleware](projects/02-epos-tcp-proxy-middleware/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md)

**Optimistic Concurrency Control**  
Letting edits proceed and rejecting any based on a stale version (HTTP 409), instead of locking records while people work.  
*Projects:* [08 Workforce Scheduling Engine](projects/08-enterprise-workforce-scheduling-engine/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md)

### P

**Pessimistic Locking**  
Reserving a resource before using it so two buyers can never be given the same item, at the cost of some throughput.  
*Projects:* [03 Competition & Prize Platform](projects/03-competition-prize-gaming-platform/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md)

**Process Supervision (Watchdog)**  
An external health check that restarts hung or leaking workers automatically (here through PM2).  
*Projects:* [11 Headless Scraping Cluster](projects/11-distributed-headless-scraping-cluster/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

**Pull Mirror**  
A self-hosted copy of a repository that keeps fetching from the original, so code survives an upstream outage or account loss.  
*Projects:* [19 Git Mirror Automation](projects/19-sovereign-git-continuous-mirror-automation/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

### R

**Raft Consensus**  
A protocol that keeps cluster nodes agreeing on state as long as a majority (quorum) is reachable.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

**RCON (Remote Console)**  
A game-server administration protocol, kept off the public internet here behind an authenticated web bridge.  
*Projects:* [18 Game Server RCON Orchestrator](projects/18-dedicated-game-server-rcon-orchestrator/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md), [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md)

**Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)**  
Granting permissions to roles rather than individuals, scoped per tenant or domain (Casbin in OASIS).  
*Projects:* [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md), [04 Capacity Modeling Engine](projects/04-cognitive-capacity-modeling-engine/profile.md), [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md), [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md)

### S

**Safeguarding**  
UK duty-of-care obligations for vulnerable people, which shape what must be recorded and who may see it.  
*Projects:* [21 Assisted Meal Delivery Platform](projects/21-nutritional-logistics-assisted-delivery-platform/profile.md), [04 Capacity Modeling Engine](projects/04-cognitive-capacity-modeling-engine/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Solutions Architecture & Technical Consulting](docs/roles/solutions-architecture.md)

**Schema-per-Tenant Isolation**  
Giving each customer their own PostgreSQL schema and selecting it per transaction, so a missed WHERE clause cannot leak another tenant's data.  
*Projects:* [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md), [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md)

**Secret Brokerage (OpenBao)**  
Issuing short-lived credentials to workloads at runtime instead of storing keys on disk or in environment files.  
*Projects:* [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md), [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md), [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

**Server-Sent Events (SSE)**  
A one-way stream from server to browser over plain HTTP, used for live dashboards without WebSocket overhead.  
*Projects:* [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md), [Frontend & Product Engineering](docs/roles/frontend-product.md)

**Server-Side Rendering (SSR)**  
Rendering pages on the server so they load fast and index well, then hydrating them in the browser when needed.  
*Projects:* [12 Consultancy Routing Portal](projects/12-unified-multi-tenant-consultancy-routing-portal/profile.md), [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md), [03 Competition & Prize Platform](projects/03-competition-prize-gaming-platform/profile.md), [21 Assisted Meal Delivery Platform](projects/21-nutritional-logistics-assisted-delivery-platform/profile.md), [25 MEEN Full-Stack Scaffold](projects/25-monolithic-relational-fullstack-scaffold/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Frontend & Product Engineering](docs/roles/frontend-product.md)

**Smart Contract**  
Code deployed to a blockchain (Solidity on the EVM here) whose execution and results are publicly verifiable.  
*Projects:* [14 Web3 Notary Gateway](projects/14-decentralized-notary-web3-auth-gateway/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md)

### V

**Verifiable Random Draw (PRNG)**  
Seeded pseudo-random selection with recorded inputs, so a prize draw can be proven fair after the fact.  
*Projects:* [03 Competition & Prize Platform](projects/03-competition-prize-gaming-platform/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md), [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md)

**Voice Stealing**  
Reassigning the oldest or quietest synth voice when polyphony runs out, avoiding CPU spikes and audible clicks.  
*Projects:* [15 Web Audio Synthesizer](projects/15-web-audio-dsp-modular-synthesizer/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Frontend & Product Engineering](docs/roles/frontend-product.md)

### W

**Web Audio API**  
The browser's built-in audio engine, which runs node graphs on a dedicated real-time thread.  
*Projects:* [15 Web Audio Synthesizer](projects/15-web-audio-dsp-modular-synthesizer/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Frontend & Product Engineering](docs/roles/frontend-product.md)

**Web GIS (Leaflet)**  
Interactive maps in the browser built on open map data, without a paid map vendor.  
*Projects:* [09 Geospatial Stream Dashboard](projects/09-geospatial-live-stream-intelligence-dashboard/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Frontend & Product Engineering](docs/roles/frontend-product.md)

**Webhook**  
An HTTP callback one system sends another when something happens, used here as both an ingress and an alert channel.  
*Projects:* [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md), [24 ChatOps Telemetry Microservice](projects/24-automated-chatops-telemetry-microservice/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md)

**Workload Sharding**  
Splitting a large job (here IP ranges) into deterministic pieces that can run in parallel across machines.  
*Projects:* [10 Network Recon Pipeline](projects/10-high-throughput-network-recon-pipeline/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md), [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

**Write-Ahead Log (WAL)**  
Writing changes to a log before applying them, so a crash never loses an acknowledged event. SQLite's WAL mode also allows readers during writes.  
*Projects:* [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md)

### Z

**Zero-Downtime Deployment**  
Releasing a new version without dropping users, for example by rolling containers over a private network.  
*Projects:* [08 Workforce Scheduling Engine](projects/08-enterprise-workforce-scheduling-engine/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

**Zero-Trust Networking**  
Treating every request as untrusted until identity is verified, regardless of which network it comes from.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Security Engineering](docs/roles/security-engineering.md), [Platform Operations & SRE](docs/roles/platform-operations.md)

**Zod Runtime Contracts**  
Validating data shapes at runtime in TypeScript so a malformed event is rejected at the boundary instead of breaking the UI.  
*Projects:* [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md)  
*Roles:* [Frontend & Product Engineering](docs/roles/frontend-product.md), [Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)](docs/roles/software-engineering.md)
